title: ranunculus dasycarpus var. macrorrhynchus
intro: Ranunculus dasycarpus var. macrorrhynchus, commonly known as the Himalayan buttercup, is a plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus dasycarpus var. macrorrhynchus include reducing inflammation and pain, and it is also used to treat digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
